evidence.excerpt: This book chapter reviews the surge protection requirements applicable to low-voltage photovoltaic systems in Serbia, Romania, Hungary, and North Macedonia, comparing provisions of IEC 61643-32:2017 (SPD selection and application at PV power systems), IEC 62305 (lightning protection), and the national grid connection codes of the four countries as in force in 2024. Differences are identified in three areas: the method for determining the required impulse current class of DC-side SPDs, the treatment of floating versus grounded DC systems, and the earthing resistance thresholds triggering mandatory installation of additional earth electrodes. The chapter includes a worked example for a 100 kWp ground-mounted plant at a site with a flash density of 1.8 km⁻² yr⁻¹, showing that the four national frameworks produce SPD selection outcomes ranging from type 1 to type 2 for the same installation. Tables cross-referencing standard clauses to practical design decisions are provided for practising engineers.
